name: Prometheus
author: austrasien
description: Local focus sessions in the Omarchy bar: live timer next to the icon, start with a task name, pause, end with a recap notification, today's apps and the week. Talks to prometheusd (~/src/prometheus); tasks are the Obsidian daily note's todos.

barWidget.description: Focus session timer, window tracking and journal tasks, all local

schema.label: Idle timeout (seconds)
schema.description: Without input for this long, time stops counting. 0 disables idle detection.

schema.label: Obsidian vault
schema.description: Absolute path of an Obsidian vault whose daily-note todos are offered as task suggestions. Empty: no suggestions.

schema.label: obsidian-daily-qs binary
schema.description: Empty: the one bundled with austraz.clock
